text: When arms have to be resorted to, either by a prince or a republic, then the prince ought to go in person and perform the duty of a captain; the republic has to send its citizens, and when one is sent who does not turn out satisfactorily, it ought to recall him, and when one is worthy, to hold him by the laws so that he does not leave the command.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XII, How many kinds of soldiery there are and concerning mercenaries
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
